text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I am heading towards the live 
concert venue along with Daitaku Helios 
and Mejiro Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the recent shift from 'Project 
Japan Hype-Up' to 'Project World Hype-Up,' 
it had been decided that she would appear 
as a guest at popular overseas singer 
N.B.'s concert.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a member of 'Project World Hype-Up,' I 
decided to accompany them—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm so hyped to blow the roof off!! Ahh~, 
I can't wait to get to the venue~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, a traffic jam—!? It's backed up all 
the way to the venue!? Major bummer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
This is bad... Trainer, what did the 
concert director say on the phone?
choice_data_list:
If we don't make it in time, our segment 
will be cut...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No wayyy, for real~~~...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Welp, guess we're running!
choice_data_list: All the way to the venue!? It's far!
All the way to the venue!? It's far!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, hold on. Delivering smiles to 
everyone is crazy important, right? Then 
running's our only choice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Knew you'd say that! Come on, Trainer, 
let's hustle!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Way-heeey☆ Here we go☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! This road is ridiculously long! 
Run, run, Palmer! Can you keep up too, 
Producer~!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ha, of... course I can! Trainer, I'll 
match your pace, don't overdo it!

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! You're the Producer from the 'Hype 
Channel,' right? I'm a big fan! Please use 
my bicycle if you'd like!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, big thanks, seriously! You just 
saved our Producer's life!! Hey, we're 
making history today, so make sure to 
watch!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *wheeze*, *pant*, *huff*... 
*cough*, *cough*...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: We made... it... *cough*...!

text_block_list.name: Concert Director
text_block_list.text:
Are you alright!? Please catch your breath 
first!

text_block_list.name: Concert Director
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! Are you really sure you can perform? 
Physically, it looks like quite a 
strain...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aha, thanks for worrying! But—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I can do it! I wanna do it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
They said my smile gives people energy. 
That just looking at me cheers them up.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
When someone tells me that! Of course I 
gotta show 'em the best smile ever and 
hype 'em up to the max, right!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Plus, we're horse girls! Doing a live show 
right after a full-power sprint is a piece 
of cake☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Right on, let's show 'em how it's done!

text_block_list.name: N.B.
text_block_list.text: That’s the spirit! See? Just look at them.

text_block_list.name: Concert Director
text_block_list.text:
N.B.... Hehe, you're right. She doesn't 
look exhausted at all... That girl's smile 
is dazzlingly bright.

text_block_list.name: N.B.
text_block_list.text: Come on, girls! It’s showtime!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's showtime!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Wanting to bring hype through smiles. 
Because she runs with feelings like that, 
perhaps that's why her smile revitalizes 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
DJ Helios is taking the stage! Everybody, 
come on!! Say, Ho-!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without showing a trace of fatigue, 
Daitaku Helios flawlessly carried out her 
role as DJ with a radiant smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The scene was broadcast via satellite and 
introduced overseas, quickly becoming a 
viral sensation. Referred to as 'The 
Sun-like Smile'—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Satellite? Overseas? Does this mean... we 
made it all the way to outer space!? 
God-tierrrr!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Footage of her sprinting all out to the 
venue spread far and wide, becoming a hot 
topic alongside the concert itself.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Look look! The viewers said they were 
smiling! This is totally a full hype 
success, right!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Way-heeeey☆
